summary: End-to-end ML platforms unify data preparation, training, fine-tuning, experiment tracking, model registry, deployment, and monitoring into a single governed environment — unlike a model API (e.g. OpenAI or Bedrock), where you simply consume a pre-trained model without owning the training or serving pipeline. You need a full platform when you train or fine-tune custom models, require reproducibility and governance at scale, or operate MLOps across teams; a model API suffices when you only need inference from existing foundation models. In 2026 the landscape has consolidated around hyperscaler suites (SageMaker, Vertex/Gemini Enterprise, Azure ML) and the lakehouse-centric Databricks, while specialized MLOps and compute tools (W&B, Modal, MLflow) coexist as best-of-breed layers.

platforms.name: AWS SageMaker (AI)
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per compute/instance-hour for training, hosting, processing; no upfront cost. Savings plans available.
platforms.best_for: Teams already on AWS wanting a modular, native 'ML workshop' with easy access to pre-trained models via Bedrock.

platforms.name: Azure Machine Learning
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per compute consumed; no platform surcharge. Reserved instances and Azure commitments available.
platforms.best_for: Enterprises in the Microsoft ecosystem needing governance, responsible AI, and tight integration with Azure OpenAI.

platforms.name: Google Vertex AI (Gemini Enterprise)
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per node-hour/prediction; usage-based for training and serving. Committed-use discounts available.
platforms.best_for: Teams wanting a highly automated, state-of-the-art managed pipeline with strong generative AI and Gemini integration.

platforms.name: Databricks (MLflow + Mosaic AI)
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based DBUs on top of underlying cloud compute; multi-cloud. Enterprise commitments available.
platforms.best_for: Organizations wanting a lakehouse-centric data intelligence platform to build and own custom models across clouds.

platforms.name: Weights & Biases
platforms.pricing: Free tier for individuals; per-seat/usage-based team and enterprise plans. Self-hosting available.
platforms.best_for: ML/DL research and engineering teams needing best-of-breed experiment tracking and reproducibility layered on any trainer.

platforms.name: MLflow
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; managed versions billed via Databricks or cloud hosting.
platforms.best_for: Teams wanting an open, vendor-neutral standard for tracking and packaging models across any stack.

platforms.name: DataRobot
platforms.pricing: Enterprise subscription / platform license; custom quote-based pricing.
platforms.best_for: Enterprises and analytics teams wanting automated end-to-end AutoML with strong governance and low-code workflows.

platforms.name: H2O.ai
platforms.pricing: Open-source core free; enterprise (Driverless AI, H2O AI Cloud) via subscription/custom quote.
platforms.best_for: Data science teams wanting open-source-friendly AutoML and generative AI with on-prem/hybrid flexibility.

platforms.name: Kubeflow
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; cost is underlying Kubernetes infrastructure plus operational overhead.
platforms.best_for: Platform teams wanting cloud-agnostic, Kubernetes-native MLOps they fully control.

platforms.name: Modal
platforms.pricing: Usage-based per-second billing for CPU/GPU compute; generous free credits.
platforms.best_for: Developers and startups wanting fast, serverless GPU compute for training and inference without managing infrastructure.
